propositions: The LLM-Review bot makes billable LLM calls per patchset review but records no retrievable token usage.
Per-call token usage is computed by the runner and attached as result _usage, but the review path only reads it for verify request count and discards the token fields.
finalize._attach_code_review_metrics should aggregate input/output/cache/total tokens across all succeeded _usage-bearing steps into coverage.metrics, tolerant of steps without _usage.

voter._publish_token_usage_metrics should emit the five review_bot_llm_*_tokens metrics to CloudWatch namespace rebar/host best-effort, plus a greppable LLM_TOKEN_USAGE stderr line, swallowing any boto3/credential failure.
Token emission runs after a successful vote and never fails the review, reading totals from decision verdict coverage.metrics.
Pass-1 finder per-finder token usage is not surfaced and is deferred to a linked follow-up ticket; emitted totals cover only Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide agent steps.
